textbookBox.concept: India has about 600,000 villages, 8,000 towns and over 4,000 cities. M. K. Gandhi said that the real India lives in its villages.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: India has about 600,000 villages, 8,000 towns and over 4,000 cities. M. K. Gandhi said that the real India lives in its villages.
beats.speakEn: India has about 600,000 villages, 8,000 towns and over 4,000 cities. M. K. Gandhi said that the real India lives in its villages.

beats.en: Every village has a council called the Panchayat, so the system is also called Panchayati Raj, a form of self-government. The Gram Sabha is the group of all adult voters of a village or a few neighbouring villages.
beats.speakEn: Every village has a council called the Panchayat, so the system is also called Panchayati Raj, a form of self-government. The Gram Sabha is the group of all adult voters of a village or a few neighbouring villages.
